page.overview:
What is St. Anger?

St. Anger is the titular track and second listed track of the St. Anger album. As with "Frantic", "Some Kind of Monster", and "The Unnamed Feeling", it was released as a single to promote the album, and is the lead single. The music video for this song was shot at San Quentin prison in California.

This titular track focuses on one who has been living with anger all their life, wishing to be released from its grasp. It connects with the rest of the album, which is focused around James Hetfield's struggles regarding topics such as alcohol addiction.

Saint Anger ’round my neck Saint Anger ’round my neck He never gets respect Saint Anger ’round my neck

You flush it out, you flush it out Saint Anger ’round my neck You flush it out, you flush it out He never gets respect
